caveat: Brands describe setup as feature-dense and easy to get wrong (b05, b18); this is where that shows up in behaviour. Email to user account holds at 58%, company account at 39%, then 2FA takes 93% of whoever is left — median 7m53s to pass it, average over 11 hours, which is people leaving and coming back. Seven-day window: a rate, not a total.

statement: Brands abandon signup at the security step, not at the form — the 2FA screen takes nine in ten of those still going, and only 1.28% of 704 finish.
